# sagittarius

> drivers, terminals & small simulations. Personal site of sagittarius, also known as @arinaholic and @dummy3ye. Linux kernel driver patches, embedded systems, simulations and fast tools for the terminal.

- [Homepage](https://arinaholic.me/): overview of work, kernel contributions, setup and contact details.
- [Works](https://arinaholic.me/works): projects and smaller things.
- [Kernel](https://arinaholic.me/works/kernel): Linux driver patches and what I test.
- [Setup](https://arinaholic.me/setup): languages and daily setup.
- [Contact](https://arinaholic.me/contact): email, discord, github.
- [Full content](https://arinaholic.me/llms-full.txt): the complete site content in plain markdown.
